yoruba:
1. AGBARA na owole,
Ijo Mimo, e yo,
Isegun na O ti wole,
Ijo Mimo, e yo.
2. Ojo ayo I’ojo oni je,
Lodo Baba Mimo,
E yo, e yo, e yo,
E yo ninu Kristi.
3. Halleluya Halleluya,
Nisegun Ijo yi je,
Halleluya Halleluya,
N'isegun Ijo yi je.
Amin
english:
1. THE power has descended,
Celestial Church rejoice,
The victory has descended,
Celestial Church rejoice.
2. Today is the day ofjoy,
At holy Father’s dwelling,
Rejoice! Rejoice! Rejoice
Ye all rejoice in Christ.
3. Halleluhay! Halleluhay!!
Is the victory of this church,
Halleluyah! halleluhya
Is the victory of this church.
Amen
